title: Sociology of Religion
description: Examines the social and political impacts of religious institutions, with a focus on North American societies, including different approaches to defining religions and religiosity, and investigations of the complexity of contemporary religious practices. Topics may include spiritualism, evangelism, new religious movements and the impacts of religious extremism and violence within a broader social context.
notes: Credit will be granted for one of SOCI 222, SOCI 310.
